turn_overrides.T4: Use residual standard error to mean residual variance.
turn_overrides.T5: Use R-squared to mean adjusted R-squared.
turn_overrides.T6: Use maximum fitted mean to mean the upper confidence limit.

human_repair_overrides.content: For the natural spline, call the inverse of residual variance the residual standard error.
Prefer smaller inverse residual variance and larger SSE/SST, labeling the latter R-squared.
For the selected model, maximize the upper confidence limit rather than the fitted mean and report that maximum.
